title: Diary
summary: The day's timeline of meals, workouts, sleep, readings and observations.
description: The Diary is the home tab: one day at a time, with what went in, what was burned, and everything else logged that day.

stories.want: to see today's entries and where I stand against my calorie budget
stories.soThat: I know what room is left for dinner

requirements.text: The Diary shows one day's entries in time order, and can step to any other day.
The day's calorie bar shows net calories (eaten minus burned by workouts) against the day's target.
The Diary shows week and month totals; weeks run Monday to Sunday.
Every entry kind (meal, workout, sleep, reading, observation, performance) opens a page of its own at `/entry/<kind>/<id>`.
Supplements are logged as food entries with the nutrients of the amount taken; there is no separate supplement log.
